name: B10-0445/2025 – After § 45 – Am 7
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 45a. Rejects the ideological subordination of EU economic and energy policies to the objectives of the Paris Agreement and similar initiatives; calls for a return to a pragmatic, sovereignty-oriented policy focused on strengthening EU industry, competitiveness and technological innovation, ensuring prosperity and energy security for EU citizens instead of pursuing ideologically driven and unattainable emissions targets that harm European economies;
